encodings.note: Load the bounds stored in a bound table entry (BTE) into bnd with address translation using the base of mib and conditional on the index of mib matching the pointer value in the BTE.

exceptions.when: If the bound directory entry is invalid.
If the LOCK prefix is used. If ModRM.r/m encodes BND4-BND7 when Intel MPX is enabled. If 67H prefix is not used and CS.D=0. If 67H prefix is used and CS.D=1.
If a destination effective address of the Bound Table entry is outside the DS segment limit. If DS register contains a NULL segment selector. #PF(fault code) If a page fault occurs.
If the LOCK prefix is used. If ModRM.r/m encodes BND4-BND7 when Intel MPX is enabled. If 16-bit addressing is used.
